findings.body: Removing `escapeHtml` and assigning `body` directly to `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` lets any comment author inject HTML/JS into other users' sessions. A body like `` runs in the page origin as soon as the comment renders. Keep escaping for plain text, or parse markdown/HTML through a sanitizer with a strict allowlist (e.g. DOMPurify, or a React markdown renderer that does not pass raw HTML through) before setting `__html`. Do not restore rich formatting by trusting the raw string.
